source.note: Traveler (geo) — one character per element; both twins map here. Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets + allStat_gen skillParam at Lv10. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Enka ingestion maps avatarId 10000005/10000007 + skillDepotId to this synthetic avatar_id. ADDITIONAL BUFF EFFECTS, added 2026-08-14: the quest-unlocked passive 'Foreign Adamantine' (nanoka passives[].unlock [603101]; the stat list itself lives in the in-game glossary, nanoka hyperlink.json entry 10050001, NOT in the passive's own description) grants the Traveler one permanent stat bonus PER ELEMENT THEY HAVE RESONATED WITH: Anemo +10% CRIT Rate, Geo +20% DEF, Electro +20% Energy Recharge, Dendro +60 Elemental Mastery, Hydro +20% HP, Pyro +20% ATK, Cryo +20% CRIT DMG — the same seven values are param[0..6] of every Traveler's Foreign passive. All seven are seeded unconditionally in self_modifiers_json, i.e. ASSUMING A FULLY-RESONATED ACCOUNT: Enka exposes neither the resonance list nor whether the passive is unlocked, so there is nothing to gate on. (fightPropMap does include passive stat bonuses — Kokomi's -100% CRIT Rate shows up there — but the evaluator rebuilds stats from sources via build_base_stats_from_sources and never reads fightPropMap, which is why every unconditional passive stat effect has to be seeded like this.) NOT MODELLED: the same passive's special Charged Attack: Rockfell (+120% ATK on each CA hit, once per 15s), a separate damage instance that would need its own hit definitions, and its +20% shield-strength buff, which this app does not model. QUEST BASE-STAT BONUSES, added 2026-08-14: base_stats_json above is deliberately NOT the raw game curve value. The Traveler carries three permanent quest rewards: +3 Base ATK from Activated Canned Knowledge (Archon Quest Ch. III Act I 'Ever So Close', step 5) and +7 Base ATK / +15 Elemental Mastery / +50 Base HP from Special Training in Skirk's Story Quest (Crystallina Ch. Act I, steps 2/6/9). So baseAtk 212.397192 -> 222.397192, baseHp 10874.914859 -> 10924.914859, and baseEleMas 15 (the only character in this seed set with a non-zero base EM). Verified against Enka: over all 338 level-90 builds in the local DB, the Traveler is the ONLY character whose fightPropMap base HP differs from its seed (by exactly +50.00), whose base-ATK residual exceeds weapon mainStatValue display rounding (+9.66), or whose EM carries an unexplained +15. These are flat and level-independent, so scale_base_stats_to_level will scale them by ~1.7% too much on a level-100 board (0.17 ATK / 0.85 HP) -- not worth a special case. DO NOT 'correct' these back to the nanoka/Amber curve values: the base-stat audit script will flag all seven travelers for exactly this.

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A4 Frenzied Rockslide: the final hit of a Normal Attack combo triggers a collapse, dealing 60% ATK as AoE Geo DMG. The evaluator has no hit-specific flat-ATK-ratio key (normal_dmgIncFromAtk_ applies uniformly to every Normal Attack hit in the combo, not just the last), so this is approximated by spreading the 60% ATK bonus evenly across all 5 Normal Attack hits (0.60 / 5 = 0.12 ATK-ratio per hit); accurate for full 5-hit combo rotations, will misestimate for partial combos.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C1 Invincible Stonewall: party members standing inside the radius of the Elemental Burst Wake of Earth have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% (and gain interruption resistance, which this app does not model).

auto.name: Foreign Rockblade
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Starfell Sword
skill.desc: You disgorge a meteorite from the depths of the earth, dealing AoE Geo DMG. The meteorite is considered a Geo Construct, and can be climbed or used to block attacks. Hold This skill's positioning may be adjusted. You spoke with Paimon about the final destination of falling stars.

burst.name: Wake of Earth
burst.desc: Energizing the Geo deep underground, you set off expanding shockwaves. Launches surrounding opponents back and deals AoE Geo DMG. A stone wall is erected at the edges of the shockwave. The stone wall is considered a Geo Construct, and may be used to block attacks. You and Paimon studied the pulse of the mountains.

passives.name: Frenzied Rockslide
passives.desc: The final hit of a Normal Attack combo triggers a collapse, dealing 60% of ATK as <e:geo>AoE Geo DMG</e>.

passives.name: Foreign Adamantine
passives.desc:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional <k>buffs</k>.

Additionally, when nearby party members become protected by a shield, when the shield is replaced for any reason, or when <e:geo>Geo Constructs</e> are created, the Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Archaic Petra, max 3 stacks. Up to 1 stack may be obtained every second in this way. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Archaic Petra, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Archaic Petra and transform into the special <k>Charged Attack: Rockfell</k>.

<k>Charged Attack: Rockfell</k>
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased <e:geo>Geo DMG</e>. Increase in DMG is equal to 120% of Traveler's ATK.
· For 15s after hitting an opponent, nearby party members will have their shield strength temporarily increased by 20%.
· <k>Charged Attack: Rockfell</k> can be triggered up to once every 15s.

constellations.name: Invincible Stonewall
constellations.desc: Party members within the radius of <k>Wake of Earth</k> have their CRIT Rate increased by 10% and have increased resistance against interruption.

constellations.name: Rockcore Meltdown
constellations.desc: When the meteorite created by <k>Starfell Sword</k> is destroyed, it will also explode, dealing additional <e:geo>AoE Geo DMG</e> equal to the amount of damage dealt by Starfell Sword.

constellations.name: Will of the Rock
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Wake of Earth</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Reaction Force
constellations.desc:
The shockwave triggered by <k>Wake of Earth</k> regenerates 5 Energy for every opponent hit.
A maximum of 25 Energy can be regenerated in this manner at any one time.

constellations.name: Meteorite Impact
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Starfell Sword</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Everlasting Boulder
constellations.desc:
The barrier created by <k>Wake of Earth</k> lasts 5s longer.
The meteorite created by <k>Starfell Sword</k> lasts 10s longer.

auto.name: Lame de roche
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 5 coups d'épée.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour déclencher deux coups d'épée rapides.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Épée d'étoile déchue
skill.desc: Vous faites jaillir des profondeurs de la terre une météorite qui explose et inflige des DGT Géo de zone. La météorite est une construction Géo qui bloque les attaques et peut être escaladée. Appui long Ajuste la zone où la compétence sera lancée. Vous avez parlé avec Paimon de la destination finale des étoiles filantes.

burst.name: Réveil de la terre
burst.desc: Réveille les éléments Géo qu'abritent les profondeurs de la terre, provoquant une vague d'ondes de choc. Repousse les ennemis proches et inflige des DGT Géo de zone. Un mur de roche s'érige ensuite autour des ondes de choc. Le mur de roche est une construction Géo qui bloque les attaques et peut être escaladé. Paimon et vous avez étudié le pouls qui anime les montagnes...

passives.name: Roche brisée
passives.desc: Diminue le TdR d'<k>Épée d'étoile déchue</k> de 2 s.

passives.name: Roche turbulente
passives.desc: Le dernier coup d'attaque normale provoque un effondrement, qui inflige une quantité de <e:geo>DGT Géo</e> équivalant à 60 % de l'ATQ aux ennemis dans la zone.

passives.name: Adamantin d'ailleurs
passives.desc:
Permet au voyageur de puiser une force nouvelle dans ses périples passés, lui accordant un <k>effet de renforcement</k> supplémentaire pour chaque élément avec lequel il est entré en résonance.

De plus, lorsqu'un personnage de l'équipe à proximité commence à bénéficier de la protection d'un bouclier, qu'un de leurs boucliers est remplacé pour quelque raison que ce soit ou qu'une <e:geo>construction Géo</e> est générée, le voyageur obtient 1 lame de pierre archaïque, une lame pouvant être obtenue une fois toutes les secondes de cette manière jusqu'à 3 lames. Avec au moins 3 lames de pierre archaïque, effectuer une attaque chargée consomme toutes les lames pour déclencher une <k>attaque chargée « Éboulement »</k> spéciale.

<k>Attaque chargée « Éboulement »</k>
· Chaque coup de l'attaque chargée inflige des <e:geo>DGT Géo</e> qui sont augmentés d'une valeur équivalant à 120 % de l'ATQ du voyageur.
· Après avoir touché un ennemi, les personnages de l'équipe à proximité voient la force du bouclier augmenter de 20 % pendant 15 s.
· Une <k>attaque chargée « Éboulement »</k> peut être déclenchée une fois toutes les 15 s.

constellations.name: Mur de roche incassable
constellations.desc: Le taux CRIT des personnages de l'équipe se trouvant entourés par le mur de roche de <k>Réveil de la terre</k> augmente de 10 %, leur RÉS à l'interruption augmentant également.

constellations.name: Effondrement de lave
constellations.desc: La météorite d'<k>Épée d'étoile déchue</k> explose lorsqu'elle est détruite, et inflige un bonus de <e:geo>DGT Géo de zone</e> équivalant aux DGT d'Épée d'étoile déchue.

constellations.name: Volonté de roche
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Réveil de la terre</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Force de réaction
constellations.desc:
Chaque onde de choc de <k>Réveil de la terre</k> restaure 5 pts d'énergie élémentaire à chaque ennemi touché.
Un maximum de 25 pts d'énergie élémentaire peut être restauré de cette manière.

constellations.name: Impact de météorite
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Épée d'étoile déchue</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Roche de l'éternité
constellations.desc:
Prolonge la durée du mur de roche de <k>Réveil de la terre</k> de 5 s.
Prolonge la durée de la météorite d'<k>Épée d'étoile déchue</k> de 10 s.
